summary: Frontend-only smoke test for IntegrationsStrip redesign and Team page redesign. All critical requirements verified: /team-portrait.jpg returns HTTP 200 and renders (natural 236x314). Integrations section renders centered 2-line heading, qualifier subline, 4 bento cards (Track Hours & Output w/ '3 of 5' pill + sky bars, White-Label Every Time w/ FluxvexMark on mint-yellow gradient, Live Channel Sync w/ portrait + 128 chip + comment chip + 'New report delivered' lime pill, One governed pipeline w/ fanned thumbnails + 'Open report' + 'Share link' + 'See the pipeline'). Team page: light gray stage, header chip 001 TEAM, 'Meet the Fluxvex Minds' heading, all 6 team-card-* testids present in 3-col grid. Navbar pages-item-our-team present and routes to /team. Zero console/page errors. Zero horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390. One minor visual issue: in PipelineCard, the fanned report thumbnails overlap and clip the 'Open report' / 'Share link' pills (visible as 'en report' / 'are link' in screenshot).

ui_bugs.issue: Fanned report thumbnails (absolutely positioned, up to left-28 w-24) overlap and clip the right-side 'Open report' / 'Share link' pills at lg viewport — pills show as 'en report' / 'are link'. Needs higher z-index on pills or margin/width adjustment on thumbnail stack.

action_items: Minor: adjust PipelineCard layout so fanned thumbnails don't visually overlap the 'Open report'/'Share link' pills (add gap/flex-shrink-0 on pills column or z-10 on pills, or reduce thumbnail stack width).
critical_code_review_comments: IntegrationsStrip.jsx TapLink anchor href=#integrations with preventDefault — acceptable as a design placeholder but a11y: button role would be more semantic since it does nothing on click.
Team.jsx MemberCard: entire card has whileHover y:-6 but 'Add member' is an <a> link inside — fine, but hover transform could feel odd for keyboard users.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical checks pass; one minor visual overlap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27: Team.jsx and IntegrationsStrip.jsx redesigns verified. All testids (section-integrations, integrations-qualifier, integrations-status, team-page, team-card-*, pages-item-our-team) present. /team-portrait.jpg = 200. Zero console errors. Only cosmetic issue: pipeline card thumbnails overlap pills — flagged LOW.
